title: Adiala Jail Tells IHC Imran Khan Is Not in Solitary Confinement
detail: Adiala Jail's superintendent submitted a report to the Islamabad High Court denying that PTI founder Imran Khan is held in solitary confinement, stating the practice has 'largely been abolished' in Pakistani prisons and that Khan occupies a seven-cell compound where he can move freely during the day, with tailored meals, thrice-daily medical monitoring, and access to newspapers and books. The report responds to a petition by Khan's sister Aleema Khan alleging his and wife Bushra Bibi's isolation; a court-appointed independent inspector had previously found no solitary-confinement conditions. PTI lawyers maintain Khan has suffered serious vision loss and other health deterioration in custody, which authorities deny.

media.caption: Adiala Jail officials respond to Islamabad High Court over Imran Khan's detention conditions
